args.message: In 2025, beverages brought in more product sales than jaffles: $2,612,975 (about 60.8%) for beverages versus $1,683,741 (about 39.2%) for jaffles, out of $4,296,716 in total. These are pre-tax sales from individual order items, counting orders placed from January 1, 2025 up to (not including) January 1, 2026.
